spots.name: Grand Portage State Park
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Grand Portage SP
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 144 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L1797492.

spots.name: High Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt. About 36 m (120 ft) tall.

spots.name: Crystal Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.
